implementation_statement: No policies existed before this engagement; a purchased template set was never adopted. POL-02 Access Control (P06) was approved 2026-08-31 and takes effect 2026-09-01. The one-page account procedure (onboarding and offboarding checklist covering SYS-01, SYS-02, SYS-09, and the Prime A portal) is due 2026-09-30.

The Office Manager requests accounts and the MSP creates them. SYS-01 has 6 accounts: 4 named users, 1 MSP administrator account, and 1 break-glass account. Gaps: a former part-time programmer's SYS-02 account and Prime A portal access stayed active for 110 days after he left (disabled 2026-07-15); the MSP administrator account is shared by 3 technicians; no periodic account review.
evidence: SYS-01 and SYS-02 user exports 2026-07-15; P07 AC-2 results

implementation_statement: SYS-01 job folders are shared with the 4 suite users. Gaps: the ITAR job folders are not restricted beyond that group, and the quality PC uses one shared local login. Machinists have no accounts and see CUI only on paper.

Planned: CUI moves only through SYS-01 and the Prime A portal. Today Supplier B emails drawings to the commercial orders mailbox (SYS-02), drawing PDFs are attached to 31 ERP job records, and SYS-01 external sharing is at the provider default (anyone with a link). Target 2026-10-31: SYS-01 external sharing limited to Prime A and Supplier B domains; Supplier B redirected to SYS-01; ERP attachments removed.
evidence: SYS-01 sharing settings; SYS-02 mailbox search 2026-07-17; ERP attachment report

implementation_statement: Staff have standard accounts on the laptops. Gaps: the CNC Programmer has local administrator rights on SYS-03 (for CAM post-processor installs), and the MSP uses one global administrator account for both suites. Target 2026-10-31: remove local admin and use an MSP-run elevation request; named MSP administrator accounts.
evidence: Local administrator group export; SYS-01 admin role export

implementation_statement: SYS-01 locks accounts after repeated failed sign-ins (provider setting, inherited). Gap: local accounts on SYS-03 and SYS-04 have no lockout policy.
evidence: SYS-01 sign-in policy; local security policy export

implementation_statement: Laptops lock after 15 minutes (MSP policy). Gap: SYS-03 and SYS-04 are exempt from screen lock at the shop's request and stay signed in all shift.

Remote access to company endpoints is only through the MSP's remote monitoring and management (RMM) tool, which encrypts sessions. Users reach SYS-01 over TLS from enrolled laptops. Gaps: RMM sessions are logged at the MSP but never reviewed by the company; one MSP technician's RMM console login had no MFA (P07); no rule limits remote privileged commands.
evidence: RMM session log sample; MSP contract

implementation_statement: Staff Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a shared key; guest Wi-Fi is separated. Gaps: the shared key has not changed since 2023 and is known to former employees; wireless use is not authorized in writing.

Planned: CUI suite access from phones only through a managed app with app-level protection, or blocked. Today the President reads CUI suite email on his personal phone with no management. Target 2026-10-31.

The Prime A portal is the only approved external system for CUI. Gaps: Supplier B sends CUI to the commercial suite; a public chatbot was used with CUI text (P10); no written rule on external systems or personal USB drives.
Planned: annual security awareness training for all 7 employees covering CUI handling, phishing, insider threat indicators, and export control, starting 2026-10. Today only a hire orientation exists.
Planned: role-based training for the 4 CUI suite users (CUI marking, DIBNet reporting for the President and Office Manager, secure CAM file handling) by 2026-12-31.

SYS-01 records sign-ins, file access, and mailbox events (provider audit logging, on by default). Gaps: SYS-03 and SYS-04 keep only local operating system logs; firewall logs stay on the device; no list of events the company has decided to log.
evidence: SYS-01 audit log settings; firewall log settings

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: Planned: monthly review by the Office Manager with the MSP of SYS-01 sign-in and file activity, RMM sessions, and firewall alerts, using a one-page checklist, from 2026-10. Alerts for mass download and new forwarding rules in SYS-01 by 2026-10-31.

Logs are kept at vendor defaults, shorter than the 1 year required by POL-02 A.8. Target 2026-12-31: export SYS-01 audit logs monthly to a restricted SYS-01 folder until a longer retention license is in place.
First assessment of the enclave was the independent readiness assessment of 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12 (P07). An annual self-assessment against SP 800-171A objectives is required by POL-02 Part A.
The first POA&M was created from P07 and P03 on 2026-08-31 and is reviewed at a monthly 30-minute meeting with the President.
Planned: monthly checks (account review, log review, patch and antivirus report, backup report) recorded on one checklist and reported to the President, from 2026-10.
Planned: documented baseline for the laptops, SYS-03, and SYS-04 (MSP standard image plus CAM and CMM software list), and for the firewall, by 2026-12-31. Today the MSP image is undocumented.

The MSP applies its standard endpoint policy (patching, antivirus, screen lock on laptops). Gaps: settings are not documented or compared against a benchmark; SYS-03 and SYS-04 are exempt from parts of it.

The firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic. Gaps: no application allowlisting; unneeded services and remote desktop are enabled on SYS-04; CNC controllers accept file shares from any host on the flat network.

The MSP's RMM lists the 4 computers. Gaps: CNC machines, the CMM, the printer, phones, the firewall, and where CUI is stored are not inventoried. Target 2026-09-30: one inventory with CMMC asset categories (P02 section 9).
Planned: a short contingency plan built from the BIA (P05), with the recovery order, the program revision check, and the DoD reporting step, by 2026-12-31.

SYS-01 keeps file versions. The MSP's commercial cloud backup takes nightly images of SYS-03 and SYS-04, but that cloud is not FedRAMP authorized and the images contain CUI. Approved plan: backup of SYS-01 job folders inside the government-community offering and a SYS-01 settings folder by 2026-09-15, then stop the commercial backup and obtain a deletion confirmation by 2026-09-30.
evidence: Backup job report July 2026; MSP contract

implementation_statement: Named accounts in SYS-01 for the 4 users. Gaps: the quality PC uses a shared "QC" login; the MSP administrator account is shared by 3 technicians; the commercial orders mailbox is shared.
evidence: SYS-01 user export; SYS-04 local accounts

implementation_statement: MFA is enforced in SYS-01 for all accounts, including the MSP administrator. Gaps: local administrator sign-in on SYS-03 and SYS-04, the firewall management login, and one technician's RMM console login have no MFA.
evidence: SYS-01 MFA report; P07 IA-2(1) test

implementation_statement: MFA by authenticator app for the 4 SYS-01 users. Gap: the shared commercial orders mailbox (outside the intended boundary but holding CUI) has no MFA; local sign-in has no MFA.
evidence: SYS-01 MFA report; SYS-02 MFA report

implementation_statement: SYS-01 enforces the provider password policy. Gaps: local passwords have no complexity or history policy; the DNC software stores the machine share password in plain text in a settings file; the staff Wi-Fi key is shared.
evidence: Local security policy export; DNC settings file review

implementation_statement: Planned: incident handling per the P08 runbook (approved 2026-08-31): MSP isolates devices, insurer panel forensics preserves images, the President decides. Not yet exercised; tabletop due 2026-11-30.

Planned: DoD reporting through DIBNet within 72 hours of discovery. The President and the Office Manager will each obtain a DoD-approved medium assurance certificate by 2026-10-31. Today the company cannot file a report.
The P08 runbook and POL-03 were approved 2026-08-31. Gaps: no certificate, no tabletop, no printed contact list yet.

Nonlocal maintenance is only by the MSP through the RMM tool, with encrypted sessions and SYS-01-style MFA on most technician logins. Gap: one technician login without MFA; machine tool vendors sometimes ask for remote access to controllers by modem or USB stick (refused since 2026-07).

Machine tool and CMM service engineers work on site. Gaps: they are not always escorted; a foreign-national service engineer worked at a machine with a drawing posted on it in May 2026; vendor USB diagnostic media are not scanned.
Printed drawings are kept in job folders at the machines and returned to the office at shift end. Gaps: no rule on who may take printed CUI; USB drives are loose at the 2 older machines.
Planned: a locked shred bin and a cross-cut shredder in the office by 2026-09-30; MSP wipe certificates for retired computers. Today scrap drawings go in the general trash.

Planned: two labeled, company-owned USB drives for the 2 older machines, kept in a locked drawer, wiped after each transfer and scanned on SYS-03; all other USB storage blocked on SYS-03 and SYS-04 by 2026-10-31. Retrofit DNC for the older machines evaluated for 2027.
The unit has locked doors, an after-hours alarm, and 3 key holders. Gaps: the roll-up dock door stays open during the shift; the inspection room and office are not locked during the day.
Planned: a visitor log at the office door for every non-employee who enters the shop, with escort and a check that drawings are covered when a foreign person is present, from 2026-09-01.
evidence: Visitor log (blank for 6 of 9 visits in June and July 2026)

implementation_statement: This plan (version 1.0, 2026-08-31) is the first SSP for the enclave. Requirement-level implementation statements are in P03 gap-analysis.csv (current_state column) and are part of this plan by reference. Review at least annually and after any boundary change.
POL-02 Part C (workforce use rules) was approved 2026-08-31. Signed acknowledgments from all 7 employees are due 2026-09-30.
Reference checks and U.S.-person status are recorded at hire. Gap: the company has not confirmed U.S.-person status or screening of the MSP technicians who administer the enclave.

Gap: no offboarding checklist; the former part-time programmer's access lasted 110 days. Planned: same-day disable of SYS-01, SYS-02, ERP, Prime A portal, and keys, using the POL-02 checklist, from 2026-09-30.
The first risk assessment was completed 2026-07-24 with NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (P01) and approved by the President on 2026-08-31. POL-02 Part A requires an update every July.

Planned: monthly authenticated vulnerability scans of the 4 computers and the firewall by the MSP, with results to the Office Manager, from 2026-10. CNC controllers are excluded as Specialized Assets.

The CUI suite offering is FedRAMP authorized at Moderate or higher. Gaps: the provider CRM is not on file; the MSP contract has no CMMC responsibility matrix, incident notice term, or U.S.-person term; the MSP's backup cloud holding CUI is not FedRAMP authorized; drawing PDFs sit in the commercial ERP.
evidence: FedRAMP Marketplace listing printout; MSP contract

implementation_statement: The 2 older CNC machines (2004 and 2009) run controller software no longer supported by the builder. They are Specialized Assets: kept offline, loaded only by company-owned USB drives (once MP-7 is in place), and listed in the inventory.

The firewall denies unsolicited inbound traffic and separates guest Wi-Fi. Gap: the internal network is flat; CNC machines, the CAM workstation, office PCs, printer, and phones share one subnet. Planned: an enclave VLAN for SYS-03, SYS-04, the printer, and the 3 networked machines, with deny-by-default rules, by 2026-11-30.

SYS-01 traffic is encrypted with TLS (provider). Gap: NC programs travel unencrypted on the flat network from SYS-03 to the 3 networked machines; acceptable only once they are on an isolated enclave VLAN.
evidence: SYS-01 CRM (to be obtained); network walkthrough

implementation_statement: The provider states that SYS-01 uses FIPS-validated cryptography (to be confirmed from the CRM). Gap: FIPS mode is not confirmed for laptop full-disk encryption, and desktops are not encrypted.
SYS-01 data is encrypted at rest by the provider. Laptops are encrypted. Gaps: SYS-03 and SYS-04 hold synced CUI unencrypted; USB drives are unencrypted.

The MSP patches the operating system and common applications monthly. Gaps: no time limit for critical patches; CAM and CMM software updates are manual and behind; CNC controllers cannot be patched (Specialized Assets).

MSP-managed antivirus on the 4 computers with automatic updates, real-time scanning, and weekly full scans. USB drives are scanned on insertion. CNC controllers have no antivirus (Specialized Assets).
Planned: SYS-01 alerts for mass download, forwarding rules, and risky sign-ins, and MSP alert monitoring of the firewall, from 2026-10-31. Today nothing watches for exfiltration.
The MSP watches vendor advisories for the operating system and the firewall. Gap: nobody watches advisories for the CAM, DNC, and CMM software or CISA advisories for the machine controllers.
